endpoint: Strict full-Vero-format greedy accuracy is the generation-control endpoint; candidate readouts remain separate diagnostics and do not alter historical experiment endpoints.
limitations: All40 records are repeatedly examined internal development:4sequence people and4Dallas cycles; clustered intervals are descriptive.
A512 and short256 are each compared only against the same-weight original256 Adam60 baseline; no combined condition was run.
Weight-checkpoint differences lack matched strict/proportional continuation counterfactuals and do not isolate an algorithmic benefit.
Forced candidate scoring is not generated-answer accuracy; cap-only candidate scores are referenced, not recomputed.
No missing emitted token metadata is replaced by re-encoded visible text; resource spans are not pure generation runtimes.
